_intrinsicOracles.label: InfiniFi iUSD/USD accounting oracle
_intrinsicOracles.note: Unstaked iUSD is the InfiniFi receipt token. Staking/locking rewards accrue to siUSD/liUSD, not a plain iUSD wallet balance. An unchanged verified accounting price gives 0% intrinsic APR; losses remain negative. This is not InfiniFi’s advertised staking APY.

_intrinsicOracles.label: Hastra PRIME/wYLDS raw exchange-rate oracle
_intrinsicOracles.note: Hastra PRIME is distinct from the Echelon PRIME governance token. This is growth in wYLDS per PRIME from the market’s direct base feed; lending APR, incentives and market-price changes are separate.
